name: electronic-structure-characterization
description: Prepare reusable spin-resolved VASP band, PROCAR-weight and PDOS datasets; extract bounded electronic descriptors; and selectively compose publication-ready band+DOS, PDOS and fatband figures.

entrypoints.name: vasp-band
entrypoints.usage: python scripts/plot_vasp_band.py --eigenval EIGENVAL [--outcar OUTCAR] [--kpoints KPOINTS] [--poscar POSCAR] --output figures/vasp_band

entrypoints.name: compare
entrypoints.usage: python scripts/compare_dft_wannier.py --dft-format vaspkit --dft-band DFT.dat --wannier-dir wannier --output figures/compare

entrypoints.name: fatband-panel
entrypoints.usage: python src/banddos.py fatband-panel --procar PROCAR --poscar POSCAR --kpoints KPOINTS --band-outcar OUTCAR --reference-outcar ../scf/OUTCAR --projection Cr:d --projection Fe:d --projection O:p --output analysis/fatband

required: A local subcommand: prepare, characterize, plot, vasp-band, vaspkit-band, wannier-band, compare, fatband, fatband-panel, dos, or panel.
The local files required by the selected subcommand; missing or malformed files are errors rather than remote fallbacks.
exactly one of explicit Fermi energy or reference OUTCAR
outputs: one wide band/projection CSV per spin
one wide total/projected DOS CSV per spin when DOSCAR is supplied

required: One or more whitespace numeric REFORMATTED_BAND_*.dat-style matrices
vaspkit-band.path_mapping: A decrease or restart in the matrix x coordinate starts a segment; segment-local coordinates are made continuous for plotting.

required: Matching *_band.dat and *_band.labelinfo.dat files, including the supported .1/.2 channel convention
A DFT source (VASPKIT matrices or EIGENVAL inputs)
A Wannier90 band directory or explicit files
compare.constraint: DFT and Wannier90 sources must have the same number and ordering of path segments.

required: PROCAR or a generic x/E/weight table
exactly one of explicit Fermi or reference OUTCAR
checks: terminal General timing and fatal markers
OUTCAR ISPIN against PROCAR spin blocks
POSCAR atom count against PROCAR ions
KPOINTS endpoints against the PROCAR path
supported_records: d-components preset expanding to five projections
p-components preset expanding to three projections

required: DOSCAR or a generic numeric DOS table

units_and_conventions.reciprocal_path: Angstrom^-1 when POSCAR plus line-mode KPOINTS are supplied
units_and_conventions.energy_reference: EIGENVAL uses explicit --fermi or the last OUTCAR E-fermi; VASPKIT matrices are already referenced unless --fermi is supplied; Wannier90 uses --fermi.

input_contract.local_scope: All inputs are read from caller-selected local paths and all outputs are written to caller-selected local paths. No SSH, scheduler, VASP, Wannier90, or external service is invoked.

artifacts.figures: Each plotting command accepts a comma-separated subset of PNG, LZW-compressed TIFF, PDF, and SVG and writes the requested suffixes under the caller-selected output stem.
artifacts.vasp_band_data: vasp-band --data-prefix optionally writes one CSV per selected spin channel and a JSON summary with input hashes, path metadata, and occupation-based edge metrics.
artifacts.processed_dataset: prepare writes reusable, spin-resolved wide CSV tables. Band rows are keyed by k point and band and include energy plus every species/orbital weight; PDOS rows include energy, total DOS, and every species/orbital contribution. A manifest records files, input hashes, path geometry, energy reference, available selectors and scientific boundaries.
artifacts.characterization: characterization.json/md report sampled-path band edges and gap indicators, bands crossing the energy reference, near-reference orbital character, DOS at and integrated around the reference, and cell versus PAW-projected magnetic moments.
artifacts.selective_figures: plot reads only the processed manifest/tables. band-dos produces one row per spin with band and DOS axes sharing energy; pdos produces a standalone mirrored-spin PDOS; fatband reuses selected weight columns without reparsing PROCAR.
artifacts.fatband_panel_bundle: The compatibility fatband-panel workflow remains available and writes figures, selected-window source CSV, provenance/audit JSON, and backend-measured alignment geometry.
artifacts.stdout: Successful runs print generated local paths; expected parse/contract errors print ERROR: <message> to stderr.

conditions: unsupported or ambiguous DOSCAR PDOS layout

scientific_boundaries.band_gap: Occupation-based VBM/CBM, indirect gap, and minimum direct gap are numerical metrics for the selected EIGENVAL k-path; they are not automatically a rigorous global band gap when the true extrema are outside that path.
scientific_boundaries.path_mapping: Comparison rescales Wannier x coordinates segment by segment after checking segment count and order. This is geometric plotting alignment, not proof that unrelated crystallographic paths or coordinate systems are equivalent.
scientific_boundaries.procar: Fatband consumes the first scalar charge-projection table after each band. Headerless concatenated collinear spin blocks are supported. Noncollinear vector magnetization tables are ignored; weights remain dependent on VASP projection settings, LORBIT, and PAW spheres.
scientific_boundaries.pdos: Only unambiguous common collinear grouped or orbital-resolved DOSCAR layouts are accepted. Ambiguous column counts fail rather than guessing orbital labels.
scientific_boundaries.interpretation: Plots and parsed values are analysis artifacts, not evidence of convergence, a unique orbital population, or a physical phase transition without the caller's independent calculation and convergence checks.

output_contract.side_effects: No remote writes, scheduler submissions, external services, or scientific-code execution are performed; local figure/CSV/JSON writes are the only declared writes.

authorization_policy.notes: The extension is local-only. It does not authorize SSH, PBS/Slurm operations, scheduler submission, remote reads/writes, or VASP/Wannier90 execution.
